review.notes: Full review. The PR's 11 corrections were checked against IFT pp. 20-26 and 62-63, RECOMP pp. 8-9, JSJ pp. 125 and 207, and GL-JSJ pp. 16-17; all hold mathematically (inequation encoding, Merzljakov sketch, 7.11 criterion, shared P_i). Seeded sample: all 15 targets read against the text (57 locators in 12 sources); 11 verify cleanly; 5.1, 5.11 and 6.2 have locator slips (R08) and 2.4 a build-order defect (R07). Gate FAIL at this head: sorry-data 14, statement-hygiene 6 and prnum 1, all in main's text that this PR leaves untouched and that #2205's head 11a9d0f replaces. The branch conflicts with #2205's head in sections 7.10-7.11, and the previous review's R01-R06 remain here (R02, P2); a tested conflict resolution is given. Depcheck: 206 roadmaps, 1898 edges, 0 problems. Elaboration: 86 sorry warnings, nothing else. ClassifyingSpaces Stage 2.7 is mapped by #1807/#1808, so it is no finding. Overlap: SurfaceTopology, RandomGraphs and GraphConnectivityAndFlows read. Not verifiable: KM06 (Elsevier), MAK, TREES. Six IFT errata recorded.
